generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working with sources that will serve you in every module from here on. Each literature search you scope, each specialist database you reach for rather than settling for the first results, and each source you weigh and justify, is this craft at work. The habit to keep is simple: search widely, judge what you find against clear criteria, and let your choices be ones you can defend.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are asked to find what is known, judge its quality, and act on the best of it, the people who do it well are the ones who search thoroughly and can stand behind what they chose. The craft you have just built is one you will use long after you graduate.
